chapters.title: The Critical Error
chapters.goal: Protagonist Artie is isekai'd during a server crash and discovers his 'Crit' stat is bugged to 1000% while his HP is locked at 1.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a mundane gamer to a high-stakes survivalist where a single breeze could kill him, but a sneeze could kill a god.

bridge.from_prev: Artie is playing a dying MMO in his apartment.
bridge.to_next: Artie must find gear to protect his 1 HP before the starter zone mobs aggro.

chapters.title: Min-Maxing the Apocalypse
chapters.goal: Artie exploits a terrain glitch to one-shot a high-level field boss, gaining legendary loot and the attention of the System's 'Anti-Cheat' logic.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a desperate survivor to an accidental powerhouse with resources that make him a target for every guild in the zone.

bridge.from_prev: Artie has survived the initial transition and confirmed his bugged stats.
bridge.to_next: Artie needs to reach the capital to fence his loot without being identified as a 'cheater'.

chapters.title: The Escort Mission from Hell
chapters.goal: Artie hires a disgraced tank, Silus, to protect him on the road, while pretending to be a high-level 'Glass Cannon' build rather than a bugged level 1.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a solo runner to a team leader whose life depends on a bodyguard who doesn't know the true fragility of his employer.

bridge.from_prev: Artie has the loot but lacks the durability to travel the main roads.
bridge.to_next: A forced detour into a mid-level dungeon to avoid a bounty hunter blockade.

chapters.title: Vault of the Bugged Boss
chapters.goal: The party enters the 'Sunken Archive' dungeon, where Artie's crits accidentally bypass the boss's invulnerability phases, breaking the dungeon logic.
chapters.stakes_shift: The group realizes Artie isn't just strong, he's 'breaking the world,' shifting the threat from monsters to the System itself.

bridge.from_prev: The party is trapped in a dungeon meant for players twenty levels higher.
bridge.to_next: The System issues a 'Hotfix Quest' specifically targeting Artie's location.

chapters.title: Patch 0.0.1: The End of Days
chapters.goal: Artie discovers that the 'System' is a dying god's attempt to debug reality, and his bugged crit is actually a fragment of the god's administrative power.
chapters.stakes_shift: The quest changes from personal survival to preventing a 'Server Wipe' that would delete the entire world.

bridge.from_prev: Artie survives the dungeon but is confronted by a System Avatar.
bridge.to_next: Artie must rally his skeptical party to attack the 'Admin Citadel' before the wipe timer hits zero.

chapters.title: Aggro Peak
chapters.goal: Artie and his allies storm the Citadel, using every exploit and cheese-tactic Artie can remember from his gaming days to bypass elite guards.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie loses his anonymity; he is now the most wanted 'Anomaly' in existence, fighting the very rules of the world.

bridge.from_prev: The party begins their final ascent, pursued by the world's top guilds who want Artie's 'bounty'.
bridge.to_next: Artie reaches the core processor where the 'Admin' awaits.

chapters.title: Zero Day Exploit
chapters.goal: Artie faces the final Admin Avatar, winning not through raw power, but by forcing a 'Divide by Zero' error using his 1000% crit against a 0-HP reflecting shield.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie rewrites the system rules to stabilize the world, losing his 'god-crit' but gaining a permanent, balanced place in the new reality.

bridge.from_prev: The world begins to de-rez as the wipe timer reaches one second.
bridge.to_next: The world is saved; Artie is just a regular player now, but with the best stories in the tavern.
